notes.title: Creative Pack #2 Now Available!
notes.notes:
Let your imagination run wild with the latest update now live!. 

Our latest free content update Creative Pack #2 adds 15 new stickers, 15 templates, and 10 new stamps and challenge levels for new fun! 

Watch the latest trailer here:
[previewyoutube=5X3aENjA6go;full][/previewyoutube]

Drawn to Life: Two Realms picks up several years after the end of Drawn to Life: The Next Chapter. You will reconnect with Mari, Jowee and other favorite characters as they travel between the Raposa and Human realms to uncover the mystery of the shadow.

The action-adventure platformer includes dozens of unique toys, more than 100 Imagination Battles and 70-plus Humans and Raposa NPCs to interact with. Toy around with millions of colors and dozens of unique stickers that unlock endless hours of customization! 

[b]If you haven't joined the adventure yet, there's been no better time to play as it's now 50% off until April 26th! [/b]

notes.title: Drawn to Life: Two Realms adds FREE Creative Pack DLC
notes.notes:
Hey there everyone! 

From the launch of Drawn to Life: Two Realms in December the team have been working hard on improvements and additional content and today we are happy to release a free Creative Pack DLC.

Whether you’ve already discovered the mystery of the shadow or yet to jump into the quirky world of the Raposa here’s what you can expect from the latest update. 

[previewyoutube=5mndphtfJco;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]New Content[/b]

[list]
[*] We’ve added 20 new stickers, including a Beret, a Viking Shield, and Bunny Slippers.
[*] 9 new stamps for your character with some with a lotus, a transistor, some gears, and more!
[*] 19 new templates have been added ranging from a Snow Monster to Spot the dog!
[*] We have 10 new challenge levels for you to explore and overcome!
[*] Added additional screen resolution support for Steam 
[/list]



[b]Bugs Squashed[/b]

Resolved issues with the player falling through and breaking animation on moving platforms
Fixed issue with the score being generated infinitely by jumping on bullets ( sorry high scores!)
Fixed issue with scoring system combos not registering correctly, allowing for easier comboing
Fixed issue with timer continuing on when draw  requests are completed 
Fixed issue where grabber toy could break by accidentally grabbing the blades
Fixed issue where ice block could break progression by going through a gem and never releasing it.
Increased Coin Bag from 20 to 50
Fixed issue where Dreamers were associated with the wrong Shadow cages on Franco Key
Fixed issue where only level sequence was saved without saving which stage you were on
Fixed several crashes.

Thank you for your support on Drawn to Life: Two Realms - we hope you enjoy the latest content. For all things Drawn to Life keep up with the community on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/drawntolifegame]here[/url].
